notes.title: Devlog #13 - A List Of Future Mechanics | New Screenshots!
notes.content:
Heyo again, let's get into the yap session.

Over the years, We're Getting Deeper Into The Abyss has changed. I'd like to think it has changed while developing it now. Originally, the game was meant to be a horror game while discussing mental health. While I wasn't happy with the idea of that, I feel a few horror games do that well already, and if you played horror games yourself, you can definitely name some. Silent Hill 2 being one of them or the Outlast Series. I feel I had a weird approach to it, so I'm happy to discuss what I originally had.

I even have old development screenshots and when I decided to scrap them. Originally, the game you started off in a hospital, still playing as the main character you do as today, Frei Kay. Funny enough, he hasn't changed one bit. Kinda.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/f15160c07eb7a6daf884c274376dfa39df1c18e9.png[/img]
This photo, he is on the stage, a flat lil' guy. The design was going to be different, flat colors and flat characters. It was heavily inspired by Gregory Horror Show. Funny, because I never saw much of the series, just the style. I enjoy it a lot. Props to the artists. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/95d920b0cca5c0b38892f861da738bf52702a235.png[/img]
Early development was just models I never knew how to make and from Sketchup 3D Warehouse for templates until I learned how to do it, (congrats me, y'did it!) I can make 3D stuff now, everything you see in the screenshots for Steam are created by me with no assistance from AI. Eventually, I'll bring on some smaller artists.

I felt like the original story was too dark, and maybe I'll bring it to the light of day sometime. It is something I would like to discuss later on without deep detail, I would like to state I wrote this story multiple times and it has gone through many themes. That's why I think it is going to be unique, because it involves several themes at the end of the day.

Let me show you some before/afters. 

This game was originally shown off pretty early on, and the terrain looked like this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/f7c1d6759d3110169186034ccdd952edff8cd872.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/6e0b45eb645997122d4c954b043e24e65a64978e.png[/img]

Then it evolved into this...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/0ab87341dac7cd21b5188b8c63f4b85bf600b3de.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/de9f150acbcd870547d04cf89191e7c223c6579a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/10b4d7e0811fdcfe3aaff737abb4957ecf117c23.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/a03ca8b94858163612af07f29bed012c0e5ce307.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/05db71e85782e4d336fcd6be3f54632971e97cff.png[/img]

Well, funny. Because models kept getting changed because I think they looked bad and didn't really feel well with the environment. In 2025, I re-did the environment again completely. Now, take a look at this screenshot and be warned, it is VERY early. Let me go over what is new.

- The old terrain I already had rain particles hitting against the ground, though it wasn't accurate, so I'm going to see what I can do to tweak what I had. I'd rather use a particle system for the rain when it comes to the effects. I have a new idea to balance out the optimization. Updates soon! The new terrain has options for rain, I'd rather stick with what I currently have as it looks better and [i]almost[/i] feels better.

- Trees are now animated, this is all done with rigging. All the trees have their own rig and weights. Optimization is already in the process for this. It doesn't seem to take up anything which is pretty rad. We'll see down the line. Updates soon.

- Working on a new grass placement system so it will be more optimized. Grass is always something that is uh, horrible to work on in games. But I will say this, new grass textures are here and look way more fitting in the scene. 

- I added different fences, too. New rocks, new everything. Lower topology, better UV unwrapping, just so it'll work better with a baked scene when I can get to it. But better visuals too. I will make sure that meshes blend in with the terrain as much as possible instead of clipping through the ground. I'm still working on this. So far, only a few meshes work.


Now it evolved into THIS. These are currently the new and current screenshots, it isn't finished as I'm changing everything. The previous screenshots before are no longer used.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/a3bdf9ae02158e4475b06eb99e7af9ce5467e95c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/896ac97e84b2c429dbfd3f8b430f7cc6cd7de6b5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/b5cfc2f6475e9976d5f0e34b4f8ff4d586c42d6e.png[/img]

Here is a video version of it, pretty short but shows you some details. https://youtu.be/zo1OKytAaHM


[b]FUTURE MECHANICS I'M THINKING ABOUT ADDING[/b]

This is stuff I usually talk about in my Discord or write down privately, but here is some stuff I really do want to add. This game really had changed a lot during development, originally it was going to be a music based game focused on rhythm, but I think this is only changing. If you're a bit upset at this, I wouldn't worry too much because I may still add some mini-games based around this. This game is only going to be bigger than I originally thought and I'll keep stating that.

- A LIBRARY WHERE BOOKS CAN BE READ, why is this cool? It isn't, but I'll make it cool. Because I'm going to make this extremely unique. Most games just make it to where a simple jpeg with text appears on the screen. See, Frei (the main character) has a very creative mind, when reading certain books, it will bring Frei into a certain world and play out in real-time. Only certain books will do this, the ones that Frei really enjoys the most. I think this mechanic isn't important, but it'll be pretty fun. I say but a lot, don't I?

- A notepad or book system where the player can see the settings and other things that are related to the game, I kinda want the UI to be very minimal, and a pause menu won't be very needed in this game now that I think about it except in some parts of the game. Which I'll talk about soon. I think I'd prefer a notepad more than a phone, we'll see down the line!

- A time mechanic system where certain things can happen at certain times of day. This means there will be a day/night cycle. Certain events and side-stories can only happen at certain times of day. Now, will there be a way to skip time? How will this work out?

I'm still very early on this idea, but originally I wanted the system to be similar to the game DEAD RISING, but I'm not really liking that. Since some players aren't a fan of that system, and there are some flaws in the time mechanic in that game too. So, I'm basically toning it down a bit. In my head, I'm thinking about a 16 minute day/night cycle, 8 minute day, 8 minute night. Some events can only happen at days and some at night. If you are finished with all the events at day, then want to skip that time? Sure, why not. I'll have a mechanic to where you can slowly/quickly skip time. I think I'll have the game go by ACT 1, ACT 2, ACT 3. Instead of DAY 1, DAY 2, DAY 3. But we'll see! Development has changed a lot already! If you have any recommendations yourself, feel free to toss em' to me here, or my Discord. I'm really not afraid of feedback. It is how a game (and everything else in the world) gets better.

- Frei will have idle stance animations, idle sound effects, and environment interaction with the world whenever he waddles around in it. Such as rain puddles, say he steps in a puddle while running, he may frown and change throw his arms around a bit. maybe a speech bubble will appear and say something. I'd like him to be extremely expressive. He won't just sit there and do nothing, this character is extremely important to me and I promise to make sure he gets represented well to others too. Sometimes, Frei can be idle and mention the situation that he is in if the player is currently lost on what to do.

- I might add an in-game guitar mechanic similar to the game WEBFISHING (seriously, great game too. Recommend it!) want to mess around with a guitar? I also might add a piano! I have met many players in that game and the players who could actually play it have told me they loved that they wish more games had something like this instead of PRESS SPACE TO PLAY GUITAR. So, I may do something more detailed.

- A BUSINESS RESTAURANT TYCOON mini-game, where Frei operates a jazz club building. Employees, songs, bar, etc. I'm still thinking about this mechanic, this is a mini-game that can only be done at night.  More details on this in the future if I do go along with it. Most likely, I will. I'd love to have something like this. I did mention a pause menu, this is really one of those times where I can think of where to use a pause menu. So hey, here you go. This is uh, not really a lot to talk about. 

- When walking past certain buildings in the world, it won't just be silent, you'll hear ambience, people talking, whatever the business (or building) is about. Only if you are near that building though! I'd like this world to be alive!

- Fast travel, I mean. This is kinda needed in every game that makes you run around a lot, right? Don't worry, I'll have this.

There is still SO much more I want, and I mean a lot more. For now, I've been working on art. I've realized something, I am going to re-texture a lot things. And I have been, I shown off the night club and that constantly changed. Let me show ya' 

This was the original one at first, and it is not being used anymore.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/96e1bfe8f521d834666f9ab45ccccef4bb54f165.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/182b3389d09555a60e28ac45830b7c810ca1d22b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/ea70fde861e94a8506d92b0a0ef88244c9666010.png[/img]

Looks super bad, thankfully here is the 2nd model I re-made of it. But I hate to say, this one isn't being used either. It's scrapped too. I made another one not long ago. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/c737e9fc2fa11160c27ad51cc915a03dcd4605ec.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/a65d28d77c04241b89ff560254add3575a833ec8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/38fcb95e8749e39b528cd5556053d91b5e1f6840.png[/img]

So, I can show off a new model, it still isn't finished. I plan on texturing this. I know the style is supposed to be a more *realistic style* of texturing, eventually I am going to try something more different. You'll see this game have different styles and how I'll incorporate multiple styles. Reasons being because of lore, I really don't want to spoil a lot, I show off the beginning of the game a lot because it is technically finished, but it is also my testing area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/9a1b8ad5057a981c7c14c4a8d15fb1c1538b9855.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/33a9bee87cea18d6cd54b2c5172cbec1a95accc2.png[/img]

 Anyway, this is my devlog. I have a lot more planned! In the past few months, I have gotten a lot more done than I thought. I kinda like to keep things private when it comes to story related things, as it really is *huge* spoilers. I wrote the town backstory, not leaving out any small details. I re-wrote the demo story, which also I'll be working on soon. I have plans for this still. The demo project isn't something I have abandoned. I'm still in early works for it. There is a lot behind the scenes and I'll show off way more in the future. Seriously, I'm so hype for this project. For now, I'll show off one image that makes no sense to you. Eventually, I'll show off more characters and more. Technically, I already have more characters made, just never really used them yet. I have a few designed already! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/d717bfdc0634f418a6abba61cd986eda17be9082.png[/img]

Thanks for supporting my project again, it means the world to me.

Here is the Discord server if you're interested! 
https://discord.com/invite/tkWcbjsBvr

Or my Linktree for other links... https://linktr.ee/ChainsawDeveloper
Seriously, thank you. I mean that.

notes.title: Devlog #11 - What is WGDITA? The Artist Initiative, who is Frei? Lot more!
notes.content:
Heyo, heyo. So it's been a good minute! But back to it.

Let's start with the fun interesting stuff. I keep mentioning GRAPHICAL CHANGES! But hey, instead of mentioning this stuff constantly, I'm just going to say this. [b]THIS GAME IS GOING TO CONSTANTLY CHANGE VISUALLY.[/b] It is in development after all, and I'm still experimenting with the style of the game. And I'd like to talk about something. 

[b]THE ARTIST INITIATIVE![/b]

So, what I mean by this is uh, well. Originally, I wanted to work on this game alone, and I still do, won't lie. But, I have been inspired by some other artists and their lovely stories. And I'd love to have some artist around (whether it be music, 2D, 3D art, or even writing) have their work featured in the game. What do I also mean by this?

Well, I have an idea where you can waddle around the town and see posters, maybe even movies in a theater. I'd LOVE to have some other smaller creators featured if I enjoy their work and have it plastered around the town. For the people who are probably feeling iffy about this, I wouldn't feel too worried. Because if I do anything about this, I'd only like it to be on in-game CDs, posters, or like I said, small 2-5 minute animations of an in-game theater where players can watch. Soon, I'll be talking more about this.

OKAY! What is [i]WE'RE GETTING DEEPER INTO THE ABYSS[/i]? I get asked this question a bit, and I'd like to finally answer this question without stuttering.

We're Getting Deeper Into The Abyss is a story-based, interactive 2.5D adventure game. Focused on characters, music, and the world around you. There will be secrets, side-stories, and a main story. Follow the story of a lone music artist, Frei Kay. Who sometimes falls in and out of the "abyss." There is no timer, it's all open world exploration. If I had to compare a couple games, then take a look.

[i]- NIGHT IN THE WOODS
- THE "YAKUZA" SERIES[/i]

I plan for the game to be as unique as possible. Prefer to not reuse assets, and not buy any game ready assets. Also, if you'd like to know... What even is the "abyss..." Well, this question is hard to answer without actual spoilers, but hey. There will be some answers eventually because with [b]THE ARTIST INITIATIVE[/b] I have been working behind the scenes to work on a 3D model for the main character. Soon, I'll share progress if this comes to light. Well, the person I've been talking with has been working on it, not really me. They deserve all the credit. So, huge props to them for working on this silly lil' guy. Once I have more information on this, I'll get back to everyone! (Such as their socials, n' such.)

[b]Who is Frei Kay?[/b]

Well, I wrote a Patreon post about this, but I'll be honest, I don't really write on that place much. It's more of a supportive place if you want to support me and get benefits. Here's what I wrote about the main character and I still stand by this fact. Take a look:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/72cf290fa6d6f9c3187b90db799f64f511980486.png[/img]

So, yes, I'm still working on other things. Designing the town is still a lot of work and I'm working on the map layout as I wasn't happy with the original in my head. I started modeling it and played around with it. Here is an example.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/3b7e4c98a453f3d709808eb578231f26e3fd0335.png[/img]

It wasn't something I enjoy personally, so I wanna have something I like and also something players could like. This map is going to evolve a lot, so keep with me on this. What is in the screenshot? Well, the game is in a fun lil' town, I'm going to redesign this town as I'm not happy with the previous models and previous design. So, give me some time here. This is going to take a lot more time than expected. Modeling is a pain and time consuming, but it's something that I don't want to slack on either. As this is something that is visually important. Also, optimization. Womp womp.

The previous models are most likely going to be scrapped. Well, the BUILDINGs that I've posted before. Take a look-

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/8968cea97c181d3d61c15430e5559b61dbe71a81.png[/img]

See, this sucks. I don't like that. See the grass in it too? I've already remodeled the grass, and trees, and already reworking the building. Because I've gotten a lot better. What changed? I just took some references for the building for once, finally. And when this is closer to being finished, I'll share more. For now, this thing is pretty meh. But, I'd like to talk about the time that we went from. It's about a year into development and it's still not that far into it. Won't lie, it's just me learning still. My previous projects, if you didn't know... Were all bad horror games. And this is still extremely new to me. The gameplay is going to be pretty large. Meaning uh, well. Players can do a few things at once, really.

[i]"Well, darn. I kinda wanna do that side-quest, that sounds kinda funny to do..."
"I dunno, I prefer to just explore for a bit. Wonder what other silly SECRETS I can find."[/i]
god so much more.

I've already announced that this game is my child and I'll take care of it til' the end. And before the end of 2025, I want to try and say early 2025, but knowing my track record, let's just say 2025... An extremely short demo will be playable. And I mean, extremely short. Don't expect a lot. It is just something to tell the beginning of the story. 

While this wasn't a *huge* content render to show off, it still does go over some important details, I promise to be a lil' more consistent. these devlogs aren't too important but I feel it keeps me and you connected, y'know? Yeah, you get it. 

I'll post more, but if you have questions, feel free to ask away, yay.

notes.title: Devlog #10 - Video Essay, Environment Changes, Artstyle Rework Announcement, etc
notes.content:
Heyoooo, another day, another devlog.

[b]THE VIDEO![/b]

This time, I got a video for ya. If you got an hour to spare, I discuss [i][b]WE'RE GETTING DEEPER INTO THE ABYSS [/b][/i]near the end of the video, even showing off a new character design from 2018. But I plan on putting them in the game, fun fun. It talks about the games I worked on over the years and me as an artist, I didn't get too deep into this game, but it does have some details in the game and what the gameplay will be about. But if you're following this game consistently, then hey. You may already know!

I feel video form is better! I suck at explaining since my ADHD lets me yap and I feel I may be rude sometimes when I don't mean to be, haha. I just suck at talking to others. Anyway, let's get into this one.

[previewyoutube=RRUlZBdMz0A;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]LOTTA NEW STUFF. AND I MEAN A LOT. ENVIRONMENT STUFF![/b]

So, okay. I've been working on trees, grass, and adding a lot of those over the time. It's been kinda... Repetitive to say the least. But this is something that makes the world look more nicer. I don't want to have the same single tree placed and same single grass model placed constantly. So, this is what I'm working on.

What happened to the buildings I was working on? Don't worry! These are being worked on constantly. I figured I need to make the world look nicer, and to do that, foliage was a focus. The foliage are painted in Substance painter, or Krita.

[b]- Trees = Substance Painter
- Grass = Substance Painter
- Leaf Textures = Krita
[/b]

The cool thing about the grass too, it has collision! So when the player steps on them, it squishes! Kinda cool, just a small detail.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/0c3f631db4d603fc261b85e44c2452706a189a60.gif[/img]

Also, when you get too close to a certain object, like a tree for an example it has an effect to where it'll disappear / fade away. This is just something that's common in games now, or sometimes it won't in games? I've seen the camera in games just have collision and bump against walls and get closer to the player, this game won't have issues with the camera, so don't worry about fighting the camera.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/d95465ee05759cd10576025c41bfa8bd865da976.gif[/img]

[b]Regarding NFTS... I say NO to them for my projects. [/b]

I would also like to say, I received an email talking about selling my art (characters of this game, models, etc) and just to clarify. [b]I WILL NEVER EVER SELL NFTs OF THIS GAME OR MY CHARACTERS! [/b]So, if you ever see anything of my character or anything that says the developer agrees of this, so uhh.. Me? No. I don't. I will release ART of my characters that you can download and use as anything you'd like, profile photos, desktop backgrounds, phone backgrounds, anything. Just DON'T fall for any scams related to my small game if you see any.

I'm a small creator, so uh. Highly doubt anything is going to happen, but still. It worries me, yeah? Just would like to spread the word!

[b]REDESIGN OF THE ART STYLE. EVENTUALLY...[/b]

So uh, I've been thinking of working on the art style eventually. This is a major change, but not too major, you're seeing the same gameplay, but the main character will be changing sprites and animations. I feel I can make a better drawing of him overall. I feel it could just be better. I made him when I didn't know anything about digital art and now I know a bit of it. So, I may experiment with some art styles and come back to the public with some ideas. But the world will stay the same. Maybe, no promises. I tend to change my mind a lot, haha.


[b]Think that's it?[/b]

I've mostly just been messing around with modeling still and I know it's been quiet, that video was something I worked on and honestly, I don't think it's a big devlog, but it shows you my history as a developer. But hey! Hopefully it's still interesting. I'll share more as time comes along. 

When time comes to share more, I tend to update more in the Discord server, so please join there. Also, I plan on streaming my game development sometimes, so check me out there if you'd like. Only really plan on streaming the game development process and that's really it. Rarely will I do anything else because I'm not really a variety streamer. I made this channel to directly stream game development and that's it. Answer questions and.. Yeah, that's it, too.

notes.title: Devlog #8 - Town Modelling Begins, Screenshots, Patreon News, Etc.
notes.content:
Alright, so let's start with the most obnoxious thing that everyone hates, and I'm sorry to promote it here. (If you want, scroll down a bit, and ignore this, you may pretend this is a YOUTUBE Ad, the real stuff is down below.)

I did make a Patreon, I'll make some post sometimes with exclusive things, there will be public posts and private post for Patrons only. So, just something I'd mention. I feel I would mention this because some people have some lovely characters of their OCs, and I'd like to happily add some characters around town.

https://www.patreon.com/freggs/membership


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/5749ef8f01d5db82683ce38f8b907294301a2368.png[/img]

If anyone does purchase this tier, they will be added to the game, no questions asked. (Well, questions are asked, actually. That was just a joke, here are some questions, or answers.)

Why is a character so expensive?

Think about it this way, I'm drawing your character, rigging them, animating them, then programming their functions in game such as making their animations work, talking to Frei, etc. That stuff takes time. In today's time, it is considered more. Though, in today's economy, I feel I can make it $100 for people to have their characters in. 

(Oh yeah, purchasing that tier, you also get a key for the game. Just updated the Patreon info.)

- What's your OCs personality? What would they say to Frei?
- I'd prefer no crazy color characters, if your character is human, or any anthro formed character that is human like, I'll be turning them into an animal. What would your favorite animal be?
- Don't have an OC? Can myself, the developer, doodle and rig the desired OC if described? The answer is yes, I'll happily create your OC if you gave me any references, detailed descriptions, anything.

Stuff like this is just what I mean, but it's a start. Sorry to promote this, once again. But aye, indie dev and full-time college? My fault, haha. Please don't feel the need to ever donate anything, this is just something to announce, once again. Now, let's get into it. I yap a lot. (Fun fact, this game will go over ADD and some forms of autism! Something that makes this stuff irrelevant.)

---------------------------------------------
[b]NON PATREON STUFF
[/b]

Now let's get into the REAL STUFF.

So last devlog, I promised that you wouldn't hear from me until I was finished with the forest area, and I am basically done, just gonna work on the cutscene transition and go on from there. I started working on the models for the town, and let me explain real quick because I know what's going on and others don't.

This game is placed in an open-world town, so you can explore. It's a very old looking town. You'll see it and understand what I mean. Though, it'll take time to see it fully. But I have some example model to show. This is not even close to being done, so judge early please, haha.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/0968ac5b03a6a9cad4a413360287883b4c2eb336.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/96e1bfe8f521d834666f9ab45ccccef4bb54f165.png[/img]]

This looks EXTREMELY early, heads up. Though, let me show you with what I have currently, as this is a day outdated. What I use is Maya for the plain flat textures and then run it through Substance Painter for better normals, height maps, etc, all those fun things. So it won't look BOOORING. 

Haven't exported it into Unity, as I'm still working on it, so enjoy the actual one simple screenshot. Though, buildings are going to be close to each other and hugging. Here is a screenshot of what I mean. I would also like to mention, there will be NO copy and pasted buildings. Big nono. All buidings are going to be visually different.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/adbc9dd97163b8250e3b4b1e173c00974604fc2e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/182b3389d09555a60e28ac45830b7c810ca1d22b.png[/img]

I would also like to share one thing too about the dialogue. This was painful to actually make work, but got it working. I added options for a simple YES or NO type of thing, so. There will be more stuff like this later in the game, multiple options, who knows. I'm experimenting with things. I want this to work with the controller, so I have to actually make this work. It only works with mouse/keyboard right now. 100% of this game only works on mouse and keyboard, not controller. (Yet.) I want controller support, as I know some people have disabilities. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/57e991699f9ab45f7525c7eb91216780681f3f93.png[/img]

So yeah, looks like this, I will say, I already moved the buttons around, so it looks different and doesn't look as odd as it does right now. At least to me. Some people may not like how it looks.

Anyway, think this is really it. Things are going well. Just taking a lot of time, too. I would also like to say, colors are going to be different in the game, not just "blue" all the time, just testing stuff, as you see in previous screenshots in Steam. Lots of colors are coming.

Thanks for comin' for this one, check out the Discord if you're interested in more, maybe wishlist the game!

And also, aye, maaaybe check the Patreon too, if you're interested. I'll post there more. Next on the list for posting, is some lore about Frei, what type of music does he listen to? His favorite artist? Stuff like that, who knows.

notes.title: Devlog #7 - Gameplay Tests Video, Model Progress, Reworked Dialogue System, etc.
notes.content:
New stuffs, and new meanings. Let's get into it.

So I've been doing some model stuff, the 3D model stuff. And I showed off what it was originally. And it was THIS:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/0ab87341dac7cd21b5188b8c63f4b85bf600b3de.png[/img]

Now, it turned out to be THIS:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/2aae46368deeb6dc4ff16f125f9d2be23d971bb3.png[/img]

Completely done and fleshed out. What was changed? Well, I did re-do a lot in this. I looked at a lot in this area and thought about some stuff. I don't like some things and always mentioned that the trees are something I plan on changing in the future, and so I got to work. These trees and bushes are all stuff I created, and the leaf texture is all created by me. Well, the bark, not me. Not yet, at least. The leafs? Yes.

Let me just make a list, blah blah.

[b]- New trees, bushes, and grass. All animated. Previously, the last trees were not animated. Only the leaves will move with the wind. The tree is low poly. I have some trees / bushes that are around 2k-4k tris/polys if you're a nerd. Nothing above 10k. No model will be extremely above that, and UVs are nicely done and wrapped. Don't worry there. FPS is a huge thing to me in this game, to the point where I completely restarted this project and moved to a new engine.

- A sign post that were completely re-textured. I'll be honest, there are 2 sign post, and I'm re-texturing the other one. Here's the one that's re-textured. I'll probably re-texture this in the future, maybe.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/29277fe174aa117cc99d4ba5bf5a840070348e9a.png[/img]

[b]- Light post that was completely re-textured.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/8b8980bd7dc4a5db079ddfd2b71f04921bdb3ea3.png[/img]

[b]- Something that is actually pretty important to the story. The podium, I guess.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/d145d5d539105a749cdc16cccb76bdc36b372133.png[/img]

That's just something I've been working on these past few days, but the dialogue system is very important to me. That's what I've been working on and finishing up this area. I know, that's all I've been doing these past few devlogs. The dialogue used to be very basic and, honestly, probably something that would've made the game HATED.

It used to be, once the player has interacted with the dialogue, it can no longer be interacted with. But I recently remade the dialogue system to where it can be interacted with again. So if the player reads the dialogue and wants to read it again, or if they click and skip it too quickly, then they can interact with it again.

The dialogue system works exactly the same when it comes to what I showed off, animations and such. It works great and runs great. Doesn't bug out and feels smooth. If you'd like to see how it works, check it out here: https://youtu.be/EGJ720LxAkM?si=VtB_LrDFrpxdwUkM

It's almost finished, the bubbles you see in the video that are dotted will fade out once the player interacts. Then will come back up to let the player know it can be interacted with again. Then it is basically done, woo.

Anyway, we're ready and good to go! This was my biggest thing to work on, really. So I should have this area done with extremely soon. I mean, VERY soon. I get distracted with other features in the game that I would like to add and then add it or either fix some stuff. If you have noticed, lighting has been adjusted, and small other things. Kinda like me getting distracted by a mechanic like this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/133634cf1472f9b133c72748c16fa0854ff87125.png[/img]

Holding "TAB" and getting an objective at the top left of the screen. I will adjust this in the future, as things such as side stuff will come in the future. So, I have to plan the side objectives and where they would be placed.

There is a lot to be done, and I mean a lot. I still have to do some animations, and some textures still, plan to do a lot more re-textures. Otherwise, this is all great progress. To sum it up:

[b]- New, reworked dialogue system.
- Reworked textures on existing models.
- Before / After stuffs.
- New gameplay video.
[/b]

So that should be it for now. By the time I make my next devlog, I'll be working on the next area. Have a good one!

notes.title: Devlog #6 - Dialogue Progress, Side Objectives, Screenshots, 2020 WGDITA?
notes.content:
Alright, let's do this.

So, dialogue was talked about briefly before. I plan on making this as detailed as possible.

[b]How will the dialogue system work?
[/b]

- The player can interact with the world, by going up to certain things and getting a popup and holding the "E" key. This will then bring up the dialogue. I will also plan on adding certain things such as a phone for Frei, (the main character) after interacting with certain things, he will get lyrics for songs and sometimes doodle on those lyrics. Writing his own inspriation for his lyrics.

- Talking with NPCs. Frei can talk with NPCs around the world, some of the NPCs can start side objectives. I'll talk about this soon.

- Selecting certain dialogue as NPCs respond is something I'm still working on, so please keep with me on this. I plan on adding certain bubbles below or above that players can select if they'd like to respond. NPCs will respond with different dialogue if chosen.

- When Frei talks, or other characters, they will have their own voice. Which is an instrument. The instruments will play with the text while it is typing. It will randomly choose a voice line for the specific character, meaning if the voice is a guitar, it will choose between 5 different musical lines to play while dialogue is playing. Instead of silence playing. I also suck at voice acting and I feel voice acting wouldn't work for this game. The style wouldn't work in my opinion. Music speaks more words than.. Well, words.

- Characters will have different animations in the game when speaking with Frei, and as well, Frei will have different animations when talking as well. 

I've been talking a lot now, so take a look when it comes to a GIF form. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/0b6a5450e997fb41d6f03ee3de781ad188313af0.gif[/img]
[i]just wanna say too, these animations have already been tweaked and look wayyy better. 
[/i] 
The dialogue system is very simple as it's done in other games, but y'know. Best to talk about it here, too!

But also, if you'd like to see how the game actually looks now when it comes to the dialogue and what I've talked about... Take a look here, because it looks insanely good. I haven't gave the random dialogue yet (well, I have, it just isn't in the video above. it's all done!)

Take a look: https://youtu.be/HgKV1HL7uuA?si=gEP-tnVPRFMNhAaR

[b]What are SIDE OBJECTIVES?[/b]

I haven't worked on this yet, but this is a mechanic I plan on adding. NPCs can sometimes have side objectives, it is something that can give depth to Frei, adding more to his character and his lore. This is something for his lore and the achievement hunters. I plan on adding some more to this. There is a lot I need to add to the game before actually doing the side objective stuff. Such as maybe finishing the main game stuff. Or maybe actually finishing the maps first. Yeah, I'll do that. (Don't worry, I know what I'm gonna do, just jokes.)

So, side stuff! What will you do? Let me give you an example. Heads up, I'm thinking this might be in the actual game, so SPOILERS for side objective! 

[spoiler]Frei stumbles upon two people arguing, someone who is a goat, and someone else who is the goats friend. The goat has leaves all over his mouth, and they are arguing over it. The goats friend was mentioning that they just bought a new plant. Those leaves were apart of his new plant.

Frei comes in to help, only to intervene. If the player decides to help, you can either get a new plant, or settle the argument.

This will obviously go into depth, but for now, I'd figure this was super silly. An animal eating friend eating someone else's plants and couldn't help themselves. You may even be able to side with the goat because Frei, is a goat himself. He likes nature himself, but sometimes doesn't. This is a silly one, but there are other serious ones that go into depth for his character. This one will go into his character, but not too much as others will.[/spoiler]

So, what am I working on now? Finishing the Abyss stuff. I know people are probably tired of seeing this area, but believe me, I've been polishing stuff instead of breaking stuff. I refuse to release anything broken. I start working on a new area, and when I test, something tends to mess up, and I get distracted and start fixing. Which is great and bad at the same time. Unity is a weird thing. I plan on fixing a lot on this game and not scraping by.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/de9f150acbcd870547d04cf89191e7c223c6579a.png[/img]

This is what it looks like now without lighting, but it is extremely undone. I plan on changing the trees in the final game. As well as the grass, as I'm not happy with it. I made the grass, but it can be better. The trees? They are a placeholder for now til' I make some trees of my own. These trees are okay, but could be better.

Well, I changed a lot in development. I plan on changing a lot more. I changed the camera angle, and now the camera follows the player. The color of the lighting is different than before, as it used to look like this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/51873a808dd60e41bd0d385d42a2d7b50edcafa2.png[/img]
[i]This model is used in game, but the color is changed. if scrolled up, Frei is standing there, but finished! It's just BLUUUUE.[/i]

Now it looks all blue. I like blue. You'll see all types of colors in this show. While I don't have too much to share, I found some cool stuff about this game. I planned on making this game YEARS ago when I was 16-17? I dunno, I'll be honest, I'm bad with numbers. Really young. Though, inexperienced. (And super dumb as a person and did dumb things. which I plan on talking about in the game with Frei.) I did a prototype of this game. It's more of art and an example. Take a look.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/caca43d8f5fd2d56f9a4a18f9ab9102bbc4137e8.png[/img]

I guarantee you, this game would've sucked if it was released back then, haha. Though, I still like the style. I based the style from Gregory's Horror Show. It had no game back then. I had no idea what I wanted to do with it back then, either. Now, this is a small open-world game where you can watch a funny little character struggle with his life, haha. (he also has cool powers for some reason.)

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/c33af4b3f9b2acb9183a0a59434b7516072fcb38.png[/img]

Last screenshot, I promise. I started finally working on the game late last year, and this is what it looked like. But, I restarted the project this year a few months ago. Only reusing [i]some[/i] code. Like, just a few lines of code, haha. Never a full script. I completely started from scratch and didn't bring any models over. I just re-imported anything new or stuff I used before. But anything I'm using that is assets from the store that is also a model, don't worry. It's there temporarily. I want to add my own models. EVERYWHERE. This is my own game. 

That's all, everyone. If you'd like to join my server for Discord, feel free to ask me questions. I'm really kind and don't get annoyed, I promise. Give me any suggestions. <3

https://discord.gg/tkWcbjsBvr

notes.title: Devlog #4 - Graphical Update, New Screenshots URP Pipeline,
notes.content:
Heyo, let's see what changed.

So, a lot has happened behind the scenes these past few weeks. I'd like to show you.

I decided to make some new graphical changes. But why? Mostly because I just felt like things were outdated already. There were FPS drops in the models since I used Sketchup 3D. [i]Used.[/i]Now, I use Maya. Also, I remodeled everything and created my own grass textures, anything you see that is a stock asset, I plan on changing. So please, no worries. I plan on using my own assets, no worries.

I remade the ENTIRE game from what I had already. This was pretty quick. Y'know, the time going and all. Let me show you the progress. I remade the entire main menu. Let me show you main menu before.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/ed75e83a8fea3559b86657b4944d173ef6f15a0e.png[/img]

While it wasn't bad a few months ago to me, I look at it now and think it's pretty bad. It isn't bad to most people either, The FPS in this was pretty bad. Like, terrible. The models would have to be redone to fix that issue, so. I did redo it. In another program, I just said screw it, and redid it. While the menu was also in theme, it gave too much away for the story in the beginning. I'd like the players to go in surprised. Believe me, this game has a lot of silly stuff, and serious stuff.

Anyway, here is this NEW menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/5a80dc98b2ec6662d284dcd3d8c6775ebd566ccd.png[/img]

There is now a logo, interactive text that when hovered over, animation will play, and options that are very universal. The options will only get better, no worries. Here is an example of the option menu. This isn't fully done, so please be aware. Well, the programming is done. But the UI isn't.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/f3e68e1763f4abc7c13ba32ba9e9c897b322d3b8.png[/img]

More options soon.

There are presets, and people must wonder what these presets do, so I put an option to read them. This also isn't done when it comes to visibility. So, take a look. This will be updated in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/26558b039dd043985ed72fae585131298b31c312.png[/img]

This is how it will look. But UI will be changed when it comes to sprites, animations will play. Everything works! The menu is fully animated and looks better than the original. The original menu did have stuff done, just didn't look as clean. Now this does. It also has a fully fleshed logo. I will be updating this Steam a bit more soon.

And to update this steam, this game now runs on the URP pipeline, as I believe the HDRP pipeline is a great pipeline, but it limits me to future planning. If I ever wanted to port this game to the Switch, for example, or the earlier consoles, it would be extremely hard to. As the HDRP pipeline is something that makes frame rate tank. So, I'm switching to the URP pipeline to make this stuff a little easier on everyone. Woohoo.

I think that's really it, though. Here is a few more screenshots. I'm getting there in development for big stuff. I just decided to remake this stuff since it didn't satisfy me, if it didn't satisfy me then it wouldn't for most players. Furthermore, I'll be updating a lot of things in this game. The sprites, UI, you name it.

Still workin' on stuff, will definitely change this lighting, remember, this is just the beginning of the game, there is a WHOLE town to explore, and the post-processing will constantly change. It just depends on what area you're in. Gonna be great.

notes.title: Devlog #1 - We're Getting Deeper Into The Abyss
notes.content:
Heyo, it's time for a DEVLOG, 

So far, I've been working on the intro of the game. So, it's been pretty slow to say the least, this requires all the boring process of models, and lighting through multiple scenes. But it's a place you'll see multiple times in the game from what I'd like. 

Anyway, what have I made in this area? Well, it's simple. I don't want to spoil much, you can see what it is, but story wise, I'd like it to be figured out while playing. So, hey.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/6e0b45eb645997122d4c954b043e24e65a64978e.png[/img]

The intro scene, woo. Just an intro scene for the player to get the controls before moving on or testing the options. I feel as a developer, there should be a part in the beginning instantly to test out settings for lower end PCs, or just keybinds, stuff like that for gamers. Or just motion blur, people hate that too. (Including me.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/f7c1d6759d3110169186034ccdd952edff8cd872.png[/img]

The teasers aren't too much, and have been seen before, but this shows the character in play. I have been working on the mechanics of the player more and more. It is still very early in development. I don't have final animations for walking/running/talking/etc.

There are several animations the main character will have, and it's just a lot I need to do. The beginning is just a start. But I have made the dialogue text in play. And the example is shown, this is likely to change in development. 

[b]Information for Dialogue System.[/b]
- The speed of the text while talking can be clicked to progress the talking speed. 
- The speed of the text isn't finalized yet.
- Different colors for text on characters is a thing.
- Animations aren't finalized.

I currently programmed the intro part, which involves an interactable, how is the interactable button in the game? Well, it's like this.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/737e8efe818b9e51e98fc6bbb047182484abd960.gif[/img]

Pretty nice, hold E and have a circular close to it.

[b]Information for Interaction System.[/b]

- The "E" key interactable button is being changed for the UI, it's just a horrible drawing I put on it, haha.
- The animation isn't finalized.
- The speed for this is currently 1.5 seconds, (to finish an interaction) this is probably going to be changed, because it already feels annoying to hold for that long, but I see why on important decisions sometimes. I'm a speedy gamer.
- Interactions are currently OnTriggersEnter, they are not Raycast systems. Thought I'd note this. (Raycast meaning the player camera must look at something before the interaction is casted, the OnTrigger is while the player is in the vicinity.)

Interactions is just something small I'd show off, because I like how it looks. The gif provided shows off a bit of player animations, as it isn't fully finished. I still need to make front facing and back facing sprites. And also animations for those. Which is gonna suck, huff.

Anyway, I showed off the dialogue, some of the intro, and player animations, honestly, it isn't a lot, but I blame a bit of Christmas and College coming up. I do want to mention this will be polished before any type of release.

There will be achievements, and all that goodie stuff.
